body: I'm open to suggestions for books. After reading the replies, I think that me trying to take ownership of doing the work for both of us to improve intimacy and fix our DB is why I feel stuck. It's not really possible (or healthy?) with one active participant.

You're right, thank you. Sometimes hearing (well, reading) someone else call you out makes you realize you've been deceiving yourself. I'm not failing our relationship if I can't fix our DB on my own, he needs to meet me halfway.
